hook: Nvidia's CEO quits, OpenAI on defense, a $1B round, Gemini 4
summary: Jensen Huang has resigned as Nvidia CEO, with CFO Colette Kress stepping in on an interim basis while the board searches.
OpenAI added two Daybreak security tools for testing and fixing code, and Google rolled out Gemini 4 Hydrogen in place of Flash.
Mirendil closed a $1B Series A led by Kleiner Perkins and Clearlake, and India's MeitY questioned platforms over in-home video for AI.

stories.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns following revelations about personal relationships
stories.summary: Nvidia co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang resigned after admitting to relationships with a subordinate and a woman identified as a Chinese spy. CFO Colette Kress was named interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent successor.
stories.why_it_matters: Huang's exit removes a central figure in the AI chip industry and the leading corporate voice advocating against restrictions on open-weight AI models.
source_titles: Jensen Huang's departure exposes internal politics at Nvidia; source: Huang ran it as a "feudal system" with his daughter and son-in-law in powerful positions (Financial Times)

stories.headline: OpenAI launches Daybreak Red Team and Defense Factory security products
stories.summary: OpenAI launched two security products under its Daybreak platform: Daybreak Red Team in early access to test web applications for flaws, and Daybreak Defense Factory to automate finding, validating, and fixing vulnerabilities at scale. The tools rely on OpenAI models such as GPT-6 Cyber.
stories.why_it_matters: The launch marks OpenAI's expansion into automated enterprise cybersecurity infrastructure, combining frontier AI models with autonomous agents for penetration testing and code remediation.
source_titles: OpenAI launches Daybreak Red Team in early access to test web apps for flaws and Daybreak Defense Factory to automate finding, validating, and fixing them (Jessica Lyons/The Register)

stories.headline: Mirendil raises $1 billion Series A led by Kleiner Perkins and Clearlake Capital
stories.summary: AI lab Mirendil raised a $1 billion Series A funding round led by Kleiner Perkins and Clearlake Capital. The fundraise comes six months after the company announced a $200 million seed round.
stories.why_it_matters: The $1 billion Series A funding for Mirendil highlights significant capital concentration in AI labs building tools for frontier research.

stories.headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast model for everyday coding and search
stories.summary: Google DeepMind launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast model for everyday coding and agentic workflows, priced at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens across a 1 million-token context. It is rolling out to Google Search, the Gemini app, AI Studio, and paid Antigravity subscribers, replacing the Flash model.
stories.why_it_matters: Hydrogen gives developers and Google's consumer products a cheaper, faster execution model that can pair with the frontier Carbon and Argon models, lowering token costs for multi-model agentic work.

stories.headline: MeitY questions home services platforms over in-home video data collection for AI
stories.summary: MeitY convened a consultation with home services platforms and robotics companies to examine the collection of in-home video footage by gig workers to train physical AI models. The ministry questioned platforms regarding data-sharing contracts, retention periods, worker consent, privacy protections, and payment.
stories.why_it_matters: This meeting highlights growing regulatory and sovereign scrutiny over how data collected from inside homes in India is exported and used by overseas AI developers.
